row.evidence: Mention's pricing page shows a single Company plan behind "Get a demo" with team member roles but no SSO or SCIM, and its help centre says that as of July 1, 2026 "Mention is no longer sold as a standalone product"; no SCIM or SAML is documented in the help centre or API reference.
row.notes: New row. Mention was folded into Agorapulse: since July 1, 2026 it is not sold standalone, existing customers keep their plan, and new buyers get Agorapulse Listening (add-on to Agorapulse Advanced/Tailored or a standalone package, sales only). The pricing page still shows one Company plan (unlimited users, yearly billing only) with no price rendered. Legacy Solo/Pro/Pro Plus/Company Lite plans are no longer sold. No SSO (SAML/OIDC) or SCIM appears on the pricing page, the 81-article help centre or the API reference; users and roles (Administrator, Manager, User, Guest) are managed in the app. The Mention API is a paid add-on covering alerts, mentions, shares and the caller's own account; it cannot read, change or delete other users' accounts, so it is not a user-management API. Agorapulse itself was not researched for this row. 'None' is by absence (rule 5).

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint in the help centre (sitemap of 81 articles: plans, roles, workspaces, sign-in, API access) or the dev.mention.com API reference. 'false' is by absence (rule 5).

rate_limits.text: Create alert: max(20, alertsQuota*2) calls per 24 hours; list mentions: 3600 calls per alert per 24 hours; 429 when exceeded.

limitations.text: API access is a paid add-on, not included in the Company plan.

user_api.notes: The Mention REST API (paid add-on on the Company plan) manages alerts, mentions, tags, tasks, alert shares and the caller's own account. Account endpoints (POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /accounts) act only on the token owner's account: 'you cannot delete another person's account'. Workspace members and roles are not exposed, so this is not counted as a user-management API.

okta.notes: OIN search for 'mention' returns only Critical Mention (a different media-monitoring product, SWA).

fallbacks.notes: Users are added and given workspace roles by Administrators/Managers in the app.
